name: Assayer Runa
title: Keeper of the Crown's Scales
examine: Ink-stained fingers, a jeweler's squint, and the posture of somebody who has never once rounded in your favor.
lines: Every bar over this counter, every tenth one into the tithe vault. My scales have never been wrong. They have also never been kind.
Silver without an assay stamp is a story without a witness. I hear the Rookery tells lovely stories.
The Crown taxes the pour, not the miner. Grettir made me repeat that to his whole shift. Twice.
